title: Afternoon Session - 2025 Meeting
description: As the afternoon session is ending, Warren Buffett surprises everyone with his intention to step down as Berkshire's CEO at the end of the year. Before that he and Vice Chairman Greg Abel cover the U.S. government's "unsustainable" deficit spending, why the health care "tapeworm" won, and Abel's plans to be more active than Buffett in managing the company's subsidiaries.
